ATL.name: Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: Delta (ATL's hub carrier) recommends arriving at least 2 hours before domestic departures; ATL is not on Delta's list of airports with longer times

terminals.name: Domestic Terminal (North and South)

checkpoints.notes: Open 24 hours for standard screening; the only checkpoint reported as open around the clock
checkpoints.name: Main Checkpoint

checkpoints.notes: Hours reported as 3:30am-10pm (Chase) or 4am-9pm (Upgraded Points); standard and priority screening
checkpoints.name: North Checkpoint

checkpoints.notes: Reported 3:30am-10pm for standard and CLEAR standard screening
checkpoints.name: Lower North Checkpoint

checkpoints.notes: TSA PreCheck lanes only (incl. CLEAR with PreCheck); reported 4am-10pm (Chase) or 4am-9pm (Upgraded Points)
checkpoints.name: South Checkpoint

notes: Delta occupies the South side of the Domestic Terminal; other airlines, including Southwest, check in on the North side
The MARTA rail station is inside the Domestic Terminal
Concourses T, A, B, C, D, E and F are reached by the Plane Train (every 2 minutes) or the underground Transportation Mall walkway

terminals.name: Maynard H. Jackson Jr. International Terminal

checkpoints.notes: Standard screening reported 4:30am-midnight; PreCheck only during limited windows (Chase lists 7-10am and 2-7pm); CLEAR+ standard lanes reported 5am-8pm
checkpoints.name: International Terminal Departures checkpoint

notes: Separate building with its own highway exit (exit 239, vs. exit 238 for the Domestic Terminal)
Upper level has ticketing and security; lower level is customs and baggage claim
During the March 2026 TSA staffing crisis the airport told domestic travelers to stay away from the International Terminal checkpoint

ATL.betweenTerminals: Plane Train runs every 2 minutes beneath all concourses; you can also walk between all concourses through the underground Transportation Mall (domestic-to-international end to end is about 1.3 miles, roughly 30 minutes)

securityWaits.summary: No official typical-wait figures were accessible. Peak security times are 5-9am plus the days before and after holidays and long weekends. During the Feb-Apr 2026 DHS shutdown waits reached several hours and the airport advised arriving 4 hours early; that shutdown ended April 30, 2026.
busiestTimes: Days before and after holidays and long weekends

ATL.precheckNotes: The South Checkpoint (Delta side) is PreCheck-only. International Terminal PreCheck runs only during limited daytime windows. Checkpoint hours differ between guides and are subject to change.
ATL.touchlessId: TSA PreCheck Touchless ID is listed at ATL for Alaska, American, Delta, Southwest and United (opt in through your airline profile)

gettingThere.rideshare: Rideshare pickup is on the Domestic Terminal North lower level, next to the North Economy parking deck (follow orange signs)
gettingThere.transit: MARTA Red and Gold lines leave from inside the Domestic Terminal every 10-20 minutes; about 15 minutes to the city center
gettingThere.driving: Use exit 238 for the Domestic Terminal and exit 239 for the International Terminal. Redevelopment work limits space in the North and South parking decks until 2027; hourly domestic parking is $10/hour, daily garages $30/day, economy $20/day.

construction2026: North and South parking deck redevelopment limits parking in those decks until 2027
Concourse D widening continues section by section through summer 2029, with minimal gate closures
ATL.bagDrop: Delta: check bags at least 45 minutes before domestic departure (30 minutes if not checking bags); be at the gate 15 minutes before departure; bags are not accepted more than 6 hours early. Southwest: checked bags at the counter 45 minutes before domestic departure.
tips: Delta flyers check in on the South side; most other airlines, including Southwest, are on the North side
The South Checkpoint is PreCheck-only, so travelers without PreCheck should use Main or North
The Main Checkpoint is the one reported open 24 hours; other checkpoints close in the evening
Gates on far concourses are a Plane Train ride away (trains every 2 minutes); walking the Transportation Mall from the domestic end to the international end takes about 30 minutes
If one domestic checkpoint looks crowded, local news suggests walking to the other side, but only if that line is moving

faq.q: How early should I get to the Atlanta airport?
faq.a: Delta, ATL's main airline, recommends arriving at least 2 hours before a domestic flight. Peak security times are 5-9am and around holidays, so allow more time then. Check ATL's live wait times before you leave.

faq.q: Is ATL still telling travelers to arrive 4 hours early?
faq.a: That advice was issued in March 2026 during the DHS shutdown, when TSA staffing was short. The shutdown ended April 30, 2026, and Congress later extended federal funding through December 11, 2026.

faq.q: Which ATL security checkpoint has TSA PreCheck?
faq.a: The Domestic Terminal South Checkpoint on Delta's side is PreCheck-only, including CLEAR with PreCheck. The International Terminal also has PreCheck, but only during limited daytime hours.

AUS.name: Austin-Bergstrom International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: AUS says passengers should arrive at least 2.5 hours before departure for all domestic flights
officialArrivalAdvice.international: AUS says to arrive 3 hours before international flights

terminals.name: Barbara Jordan Terminal

checkpoints.notes: From October 20, 2026: TSA PreCheck, PreCheck Touchless ID, CLEAR with PreCheck, Known Crew Member, ADA and Priority/Premium screening.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint 1

checkpoints.notes: From October 20, 2026: TSA PreCheck only.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint 2

checkpoints.notes: From October 20, 2026: general screening, CLEAR for general screening, ADA and Priority/Premium screening.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint 3

checkpoints.notes: General screening only. Opened February 23, 2026, in the West Infill on the far west side of the terminal, with easier access to Gates 22 and above. AUS says a future central checkpoint will eventually replace it.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint 4

notes: All airlines now fly from the Barbara Jordan Terminal. The South Terminal closed March 31, 2026, and Allegiant and Frontier moved over on April 1.
All four checkpoints lead to all gates
The first checkpoints typically open at 3am daily
AUS says travelers with a REAL ID can use dedicated lanes at all checkpoints
Curbside check-in is offered by select airlines on the upper level

AUS.betweenTerminals: Single terminal. All four checkpoints lead to all gates, so you can reach any gate after screening.

securityWaits.summary: AUS officials said in March 2026 that TSA checkpoints are busiest from about 3 to 7am, with departures peaking 6-7am. AUS calls a day with more than 35,000 departing passengers high-volume. In spring 2026, Sundays and Mondays were its busiest days. Lines stretched outside the terminal on the peak Friday of spring break 2026.
busiestTimes: Sundays and Mondays during busy seasons

AUS.precheckNotes: As of October 20, 2026, PreCheck lanes are at Checkpoints 1 and 2 only. Checkpoints 3 and 4 are general screening. AUS did not publish PreCheck lane hours.
AUS.touchlessId: AUS lists TSA PreCheck Touchless ID at Checkpoint 1. A March 2026 airport list shows it at AUS for American. You opt in through your airline profile.

gettingThere.rideshare: Drop-off is at the upper level (departures) curb. Rideshare and taxi pickup is on the ground level under the Consolidated Rental Car Facility, just north of (behind) the Red Garage. Mobility trams run from the garages and terminal to the rideshare area.
gettingThere.transit: CapMetro Route 20 stops on the lower level just outside baggage claim. It runs every 15-30 minutes, seven days a week, and takes about 35 minutes to downtown. A single ride is $1.25.
gettingThere.driving: Both the upper and lower roadways are open for drop-off; AUS says to use whichever is less crowded. On-site parking can sell out, so book ahead at ABIAParking.com. Economy Lot shuttles run every 15-20 minutes. The free cell phone lot at 2901 Spirit of Texas Drive is open 24/7.

construction2026: Atrium Infill between Checkpoints 2 and 3 in the Departures Hall: construction walls, adjusted queue lines and a different flow when busy. It adds screening, bag check and processing space and is planned to finish in 2026.
West Gate Expansion (August 2023 to late 2026) is past security on the west side, with temporary walls and barriers. It replaces 12 boarding bridges and adds 3 gates.

Yellow Garage construction next to the Blue Garage (finish expected early 2027): shifting traffic around the Blue Garage exits, flaggers and lower speeds. The Blue Garage exit ramp closes at times from 1am to 8am, and drivers exit through the Red Garage toll booth.
AUS says Journey With AUS construction continues across the campus; check flyaustin.com/construction-updates before you go
AUS.bagDrop: American: check-in and bag deadline is 45 minutes before domestic departure. Southwest: bags checked less than 45 minutes before a domestic departure may not be accepted (60 minutes for international); bags are accepted no earlier than 4 hours ahead. Delta: check bags at least 45 minutes before domestic departure, no more than 6 hours ahead.
tips: AUS asks for 2.5 hours before domestic flights, more than most US airports. Plan for that, especially before 7am.
Pick your checkpoint by your lane type. PreCheck is only at Checkpoints 1 and 2, and CLEAR is at 1 (with PreCheck) and 3 (general).
Checkpoint 4 on the far west side is general screening only and is closest to Gates 22 and up
Allegiant and Frontier no longer use the South Terminal. Go to the Barbara Jordan Terminal for every airline.
Garages can sell out on busy days. Book parking ahead and allow for Economy Lot shuttle time.

faq.q: How early should I get to Austin airport?
faq.a: AUS recommends at least 2.5 hours before domestic flights and 3 hours before international flights. Allow more if you are checking bags or returning a rental car.

faq.q: Which checkpoint has TSA PreCheck at AUS?
faq.a: As of October 20, 2026, Checkpoints 1 and 2 have PreCheck. Checkpoint 1 also has CLEAR with PreCheck and Touchless ID. Checkpoints 3 and 4 are general screening.

faq.q: Is the South Terminal at Austin airport still open?
faq.a: No. The South Terminal closed March 31, 2026. Allegiant and Frontier now fly from the Barbara Jordan Terminal with all other airlines.

faq.q: Where do I get an Uber or Lyft at AUS?
faq.a: Drop-off is at the upper level curb. Pickup is on the ground level under the Consolidated Rental Car Facility, behind the Red Garage. Trams run there from the terminal and garages.

BNA.name: Nashville International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: BNA's fall break tips say to arrive 2 hours before domestic flights and to leave time for parking (WSMV, Sept 30, 2026). Southwest also suggests 120 minutes at BNA.
officialArrivalAdvice.international: BNA's fall break tips say to arrive 3 hours before international flights (WSMV, Sept 30, 2026)

terminals.name: Main Terminal (Grand Lobby)

checkpoints.notes: On Level 3 (departures) in the Grand Lobby and serves all concourses. It opened with 24 lanes in January 2023. Upgraded Points (Sept 2026) says it opens daily at 3:30am; closing time not confirmed. Has dedicated PreCheck lanes; TSA sets PreCheck hours.
checkpoints.name: Central Security Checkpoint, Level 3

notes: Concourse B (gates B1, B3-B11): Delta and United, per Upgraded Points (Sept 2026)

Concourse C (C1-C3, C13-C27): American and Southwest. Gates C4-C11 are a satellite reached by shuttle bus from near gate C2; Upgraded Points lists Air Canada, Allegiant, Avelo, Contour, JetBlue, Porter and Sun Country there
Concourse D (D1-D11): Southwest. Southwest lists its BNA gates as C4, C7, C9, C16, C18-C22, C25 and D1-D6
T Gates, just past security: Alaska, Frontier and international carriers including Aer Lingus, British Airways, Icelandair, WestJet and Viva Aerobus. All international arrivals use Concourse T
Concourse A is closed and being rebuilt; the new 16-gate Concourse A is due in July 2028
If you park in a terminal garage, you enter the terminal on Level 1. The Level 5 pedestrian bridge is closed during construction

BNA.betweenTerminals: Single terminal. After security you can walk between Concourses B, C, D and T. Gates C4-C11 are a satellite reached by shuttle bus from near gate C2.

securityWaits.summary: BNA does not publish an hourly wait pattern that this research could find. Fall break is its busiest period: it set a one-day record of 116,047 passengers on Oct 5, 2025. For fall break 2025, BNA named Sundays, Mondays, Thursdays and Fridays as high-volume days, and TSA added staff Thursday through Monday. BNA also warned of longer parking, check-in and security waits on Monday, Sept 21, 2026.
busiestTimes: Sundays, Mondays, Thursdays and Fridays at busy times (BNA fall break 2025 plan)

BNA.precheckNotes: The central checkpoint has dedicated PreCheck lanes. Upgraded Points says to check TSA for PreCheck hours because they vary. This research could not confirm PreCheck closing times.
BNA.touchlessId: Southwest's BNA page lists a TSA PreCheck Touchless ID checkpoint (opt in through your airline profile). A March 2026 list showed BNA as being added by late spring.

gettingThere.rideshare: Drop-off is at the Level 3 departures curb in front of the terminal. Uber and Lyft pickup is at the Ground Transportation Center on Level 1 of Terminal Garage 2. A local guide (Oct 2026) says Lyft uses Zone A and Uber Zones B and C.
gettingThere.transit: WeGo Route 18 Airport runs to WeGo Central downtown from the Ground Transportation Center (Level 1, Terminal Garage 2). Express trips take about 20 minutes and local trips 35-45 minutes. Since July 5, 2026, it runs every 30 minutes from 6am to 6pm, seven days a week, and every 40 minutes in the evening. Fare is $2.
gettingThere.driving: Construction is underway, so BNA suggests learning the alternate route from Murfreesboro Pike and I-40 Exit 216B. Terminal Lot A closed July 1, 2026. Terminal Garages 1 and 2, Economy Lots B and C, and valet remain; economy shuttles leave from Level 2 arrivals about every 10 minutes. Since Sept 23, 2026, Garage 1 has no exit: drive through to Garage 2, take the helix down to Level P2 and pay there. The free cell lot is at 1415 Murfreesboro Pike.

construction2026: Central Core Enhancement: the main escalator and elevator hub closed June 1, 2026, for an 18-month, $40 million rebuild expected to run through December 2027
The Level 5 pedestrian bridge from the garages is closed, so garage parkers enter the terminal on Level 1
Concourse A is closed for demolition and rebuilding; the new 16-gate concourse is expected in July 2028
Terminal Lot A closed July 1, 2026, for a new rental car facility and parking garage
The Terminal Garage 1 exit closed Sept 23, 2026; drivers exit through Terminal Garage 2. BNA says more roadway changes are expected this fall
BNA.bagDrop: Southwest: check bags at least 45 minutes before domestic departure (60 minutes for international) and check in at least 30 minutes before domestic departure. Be at the gate 10 minutes before departure. Its BNA ticket counter opens 90 minutes before the first departing flight. American, United and Delta: check bags at least 45 minutes before domestic departure. Alaska: check in at least 50 minutes before domestic departure.
tips: There is one central checkpoint, on Level 3 in the Grand Lobby, and it serves all concourses
Parking in a garage? Allow extra walking time. You enter the terminal on Level 1 because the Level 5 bridge is closed until the Central Core work ends (expected December 2027)
Lot A is closed. Use the terminal garages, Economy Lots B and C, or valet. Leaving Garage 1, follow signs to Garage 2 to exit
If traffic backs up on the usual route, BNA suggests the Murfreesboro Pike and I-40 Exit 216B approach
Southwest's BNA ticket counter opens 90 minutes before the first flight of the day, so very early flyers should check in online
Gates C4-C11 are on a satellite reached by shuttle bus from near gate C2, so leave extra time if your flight leaves from one of them

faq.q: How early should I get to Nashville airport?
faq.a: BNA says to arrive 2 hours before a domestic flight and 3 hours before an international flight. Leave extra time for parking and construction detours.

faq.q: How many security checkpoints does BNA have?
faq.a: One. The central checkpoint on Level 3 in the Grand Lobby has 24 lanes and serves all concourses. It opens at 3:30am, and it has PreCheck lanes.

faq.q: Where do Uber and Lyft pick up at Nashville airport?
faq.a: At the Ground Transportation Center on Level 1 of Terminal Garage 2. Drop-off is at the Level 3 departures curb.

faq.q: Is Lot A still open at BNA?
faq.a: No. Terminal Lot A closed July 1, 2026, to make room for a new garage and rental car facility. The terminal garages, Economy Lots B and C, and valet are still open.

faq.q: Can I take a bus from BNA to downtown Nashville?
faq.a: Yes. WeGo Route 18 Airport leaves from Level 1 of Terminal Garage 2 and costs $2. Express trips take about 20 minutes. Buses run every 30 minutes from 6am to 6pm.

BOS.name: Boston Logan International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: Massport recommends arriving 2 hours before domestic departures
officialArrivalAdvice.international: Massport recommends arriving 3 hours before international departures

terminals.name: Terminal A

checkpoints.notes: CLEAR+ lanes are to the right of the security checkpoint entrance. Hours are Sun-Fri 4:00am-7:30pm and Sat 4:00am-6:30pm.
checkpoints.name: Terminal A security

notes: Delta flies most domestic flights from Terminal A. All Delta international flights use Terminal E.
Terminal A is not connected to the other terminals after security
A free Delta shuttle runs between Terminals A and E (4:45am-11:00pm). Alternatively, take the Skywalk Bridge from the Terminal A lobby, about a 5-minute walk to Terminal E.
Ride-app pickup and drop-off for Terminal A is in the Central Parking Garage

terminals.name: Terminal B

checkpoints.notes: CLEAR+ hours are Sun-Fri 4:00am-6:00pm and Sat 4:00am-5:30pm
checkpoints.name: Terminal B security

notes: Terminal B has two sides: one serving Air Canada, American and Alaska, the other serving Southwest and United
Since 9/1, the pedestrian bridge from Terminal A to the Air Canada/American/Alaska side of Terminal B is closed. Follow the detour or take the on-airport shuttle.
Pre-security escalators on the Southwest/United side may be out of service through November. Use the elevators.
Ride-app pickup and drop-off is on Level 2 (Departures) of the Terminal B parking garage

terminals.name: Terminal C

checkpoints.notes: CLEAR+ hours are 4:00am-8:00pm. JetBlue lists the checkpoint hours as 3:00am-11:30pm.
checkpoints.name: Terminal C security

notes: JetBlue domestic and international departures leave from Terminal C. JetBlue international arrivals use Terminal E.
The bus stop for Logan Express, hotel shuttles, the Uber/Lyft Shuttle and shared vans has moved to Door C102, near the Logan Chapel
Ride-app pickup and drop-off for Terminal C is in the Central Parking Garage

terminals.name: Terminal E

checkpoints.notes: CLEAR+ hours are 4:30am-8:30pm
checkpoints.name: Terminal E security

notes: Terminal E is Logan's primary international terminal, though international flights can depart from any terminal
Vestibules E101 and E102 and the Terminal E-C Arrivals Level sidewalk are closed. The Terminal E taxi stand is now outside Door E107.
Ride-app pickup and drop-off for Terminal E is in the Central Parking Garage

BOS.betweenTerminals: Terminals B, C and E are connected after security. Terminal A is not, so you reach it by pre-security walkways or the free On-Airport Shuttle. Shuttle Route 11 links Terminals A, B, C and E (9am-10pm), and shuttles generally run every 5-6 minutes.
BOS.precheckNotes: TSA PreCheck lanes are available in all terminals. Checkpoints normally open 2 hours before the first departure of the day. On CLEAR, sources differ: Massport's security page names Terminals A and B, while CLEAR's own location page lists lanes in A, B, C and E.
BOS.touchlessId: Delta lists BOS for TSA PreCheck Touchless ID, with dedicated Touchless ID bag drop. Southwest also lists BOS.

gettingThere.rideshare: Ride-app drop-off and pickup for Terminals A, C and E is in the Central Parking Garage. For Terminal B it is on Level 2 (Departures) of the Terminal B parking garage. Accessible ride-app drop-offs use the upper Departures curb.
gettingThere.transit: The Silver Line SL1 runs from all terminals to South Station and is free from the airport. For the Blue Line, take free Massport shuttle Route 22, 33, 55 or 66 to Airport Station. Logan Express buses run from Back Bay ($3 to the airport, free back) and from Braintree, Danvers, Framingham and Woburn ($9 each way online, $7/day parking). The Braintree stop is moving to the MBTA Quincy Adams Garage on Tuesday, 11/3. An MBTA ferry connects to Long Wharf via shuttle Route 66.
gettingThere.driving: Pre-booking parking online guarantees a space. Garages fill earliest on Tuesday and Wednesday mornings and during the February and April school vacation weeks. Economy Parking is capped at $37 per day and the Terminal B Garage at $46 per day.

construction2026: Runway 9-27 is closed for the second and final phase of FAA-required runway safety work. The closure began Aug 31, 2026 for about 75 days, ongoing through November. Expect flight delays, especially in the afternoons and evenings.
Since 9/1, the pedestrian bridge from Terminal A to the Air Canada/American/Alaska side of Terminal B is closed. Use the detour or the on-airport shuttle.
Terminal B pre-security escalators on the Southwest/United side may be out of service through November
Terminal C bus stop (Logan Express, hotel shuttles, Uber/Lyft Shuttle, shared vans) has moved to Door C102
Terminal E: vestibules E101 and E102 and the E-C Arrivals sidewalk are closed, and the taxi stand has moved to Door E107
The Braintree Logan Express stop is moving to the MBTA Quincy Adams Garage on Tuesday, 11/3
BOS.bagDrop: Delta (no BOS-specific exception): bags must be checked at least 45 minutes before domestic departures, international check-in closes 1 hour before, and you must be at the gate 15 minutes before departure. JetBlue at BOS: check-in and bags 45 minutes before domestic departures and 60 minutes before international.
tips: Terminal A is not connected to the other terminals after security. If you are in the wrong terminal, you will have to clear security again.
Uber and Lyft drop you at the Central Parking Garage for Terminals A, C and E, not at the curb. Allow a few extra minutes to walk in.
The Silver Line SL1 runs directly to every terminal from South Station. Massport says it is free from the airport to downtown.
Runway 9-27 work through November can cause afternoon and evening delays. Check your flight status before you leave.
Logan garages fill earliest on Tuesday and Wednesday mornings, so pre-book parking if you are driving

faq.q: How early should I get to Boston Logan?
faq.a: Massport recommends arriving 2 hours before domestic departures and 3 hours before international departures. Check with your airline during peak travel periods.

faq.q: Can I walk between terminals at Logan after security?
faq.a: Terminals B, C and E are connected after security, but Terminal A is not. For Terminal A, use the pre-security walkways or the free On-Airport Shuttle.

faq.q: Where do Uber and Lyft drop off at Logan?
faq.a: For Terminals A, C and E, ride apps use the Central Parking Garage. For Terminal B, they use Level 2 (Departures) of the Terminal B parking garage.

BWI.name: Baltimore/Washington International Thurgood Marshall Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: BWI's security page says TSA currently recommends arriving 2 hours before scheduled domestic flights
officialArrivalAdvice.international: BWI's security page says TSA recommends arriving 3 hours before international flights

terminals.name: Concourses A, B and C (Main Terminal)

checkpoints.notes: BWI lists screening 4am-8pm. Upgraded Points (May 2026) says PreCheck runs here only when operationally needed, and CLEAR 4am-7:30pm. Leads to Concourses A, B and C.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint A

checkpoints.notes: BWI's security page lists screening as open 24 hours. Upgraded Points (May 2026) lists 4am-9:45pm, with PreCheck and CLEAR 4am-9pm. Leads to Concourses A, B and C.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint B

checkpoints.notes: BWI lists screening 4am-8pm. Upgraded Points (May 2026) says PreCheck runs here only when operationally needed, and CLEAR 4am-9pm. Leads to Concourses A, B and C.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint C

notes: Southwest flies from Concourses A, B and C (and E for some flights); American and Contour use Concourse C
Concourses A, B and C share one secure area, so any of Checkpoints A, B or C reaches all three
A new A/B Connector opened January 9, 2026, adding a direct link between Concourses A and B
Upgraded Points says Checkpoints A, B or C may be closed when passenger volumes are low

terminals.name: Concourses D and E (Main Terminal)

checkpoints.notes: BWI's security page lists screening as open 24 hours. Upgraded Points (May 2026) lists 4am-9:15pm, with PreCheck 4am-8pm and CLEAR 4am-9pm.
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint D/E

notes: BWI lists Alaska, Avelo, BermudAir, Delta, Frontier, JetBlue, Sun Country and United at Concourse D
Breeze, British Airways, Copa, Icelandair and some Southwest flights use Concourse E (the international concourse)
D/E has its own checkpoint, separate from A/B/C

BWI.betweenTerminals: All concourses are in one terminal building. Concourses A, B and C connect airside, and D and E connect to each other. But D/E is not linked airside to A/B/C, so moving between the two groups means walking through the terminal and clearing security again.

securityWaits.summary: BWI publishes daily peak periods. Mornings peak at 5-8am on Monday, Thursday and Friday, and 6-8am on other days. Afternoon peaks vary by day, with the longest on Thursday (3-7pm) and Sunday (4-7pm). In March 2026, local news reported that A/B/C (Southwest and American) had the longest lines, while D/E saw normal to no waits. Real-time waits are on BWI's homepage.

BWI.precheckNotes: Upgraded Points (May 2026) lists regular PreCheck lanes at Checkpoint B (4am-9pm) and Checkpoint D/E (4am-8pm). It says Checkpoints A and C open PreCheck only when operationally needed. BWI does not publish PreCheck hours by checkpoint, so confirm before a late flight.
BWI.touchlessId: A March 2026 list of TSA PreCheck Touchless ID airports shows BWI for American only. You opt in through your airline profile.

gettingThere.rideshare: Rideshare pickup and drop-off is on the outer curb of the Departures/Upper Level, between Doors 5 and 12.
gettingThere.transit: MTA Light Rail stops just outside the lower level next to Concourse E. It runs to downtown Baltimore, Timonium and Hunt Valley for $2.00 each way. First trains arrive at 4:45am on weekdays and 5:05am on Saturdays, but not until 10:35am on Sundays and holidays. MARC and Amtrak use the BWI rail station; a free 24-hour shuttle drops you near your airline's check-in counter.
gettingThere.driving: BWI listed these rates: Hourly Garage (closest) $6/hour or $30/day; Daily Garage $16/day; Express Parking $14/day; Long Term A and B $11/day. Lots can fill and close, and drivers are then sent to other lots. A free cell phone lot is available for pickups.

construction2026: The Concourse A/B Connector and new Southwest baggage system opened January 9, 2026, with a direct A-B link and relocated gate areas
BWI's construction page lists ongoing passenger boarding bridge replacement and restroom renovations, without dates or passenger impacts
BWI.bagDrop: Southwest: bags checked less than 45 minutes before a domestic departure may not be accepted; international bags must be checked at the counter at least 60 minutes ahead. Southwest accepts bags no earlier than 4 hours before departure. Delta: check bags at least 45 minutes before domestic departure, and no more than 6 hours ahead. American: check-in and bag deadline is 45 minutes before domestic departure.
tips: Check your concourse before you go. D/E (Delta, United, JetBlue, Frontier, most international flights) has its own checkpoint and is not connected airside to A/B/C.
Southwest carries most of BWI's traffic and uses A, B and C. Those checkpoints have had the longest lines at busy times.
If you have PreCheck and fly from A/B/C, head to Checkpoint B. Checkpoints A and C may not have PreCheck lanes open.

Rideshare drop-off is on the upper level outer curb between Doors 5 and 12.

faq.q: How early should I get to BWI airport?
faq.a: BWI passes on TSA's advice: 2 hours before a domestic flight and 3 hours before an international flight. Allow more time if you fly Southwest or American from Concourses A-C at morning peaks (5-8am).

faq.q: Can I walk from Concourse D to Concourse A after security at BWI?
faq.a: No. Concourses A, B and C share one secure area, and D and E share another. To switch between them you must walk through the terminal and clear security again.

faq.q: Which concourse is Southwest at BWI?
faq.a: BWI lists Southwest at Concourses A, B, C and E. Most domestic Southwest flights leave from A, B or C, and E handles international flights.

faq.q: Is BWI security open 24 hours?
faq.a: BWI lists Checkpoints B and D/E as open 24 hours, with A and C open 4am to 8pm. A May 2026 third-party guide lists shorter hours for B and D/E, and BWI says hours can change. Late-night flyers should check bwiairport.com.

tips: After 8pm, Checkpoints 1 and 3 close and only Checkpoint 2 stays open, until 11pm. Once all checkpoints close, no one is allowed past security.

TSA PreCheck members flying American can use the Touchless ID lane at Checkpoint 2 if they've opted in through their AAdvantage profile

EWR.betweenTerminals: There is no walkway between terminals after security. A continuous airside shuttle links Terminals A and C after TSA screening. The free AirTrain connects Terminals B and C, parking and the Airport Train Station before security, but it does not stop directly at Terminal A.
EWR.precheckNotes: CLEAR's EWR page places the Terminal C CLEAR lane overlooking the TSA PreCheck checkpoint. We could not confirm PreCheck details for Terminals A and B on the airport site.
EWR.touchlessId: Delta lists EWR for TSA PreCheck Touchless ID at security, but not for dedicated Touchless ID bag drop. Southwest's list does not include EWR. We could not confirm United's Touchless ID at EWR.

gettingThere.rideshare: Drop-off is in front of each terminal. Pickups: Terminal A on the Arrivals level, directly across the street from the terminal. Terminal B on the Arrivals-level frontage. Terminal C on Level 3 of the Terminal C garage.
gettingThere.transit: NJ Transit (Northeast Corridor or North Jersey Coast Line) and Amtrak stop at Newark Liberty Airport Station, which links to the terminals by AirTrain ($8.75 each way). NJ Transit to Midtown Manhattan takes about 30 minutes. Through Nov 20, 2026, AirTrain service to and from the Airport Train Station is suspended on weekdays from 5am to 3pm, with shuttle buses running instead. The Newark Airport Express bus serves Grand Central, Bryant Park and Port Authority Bus Terminal in about 50 minutes ($23.50 one way).
gettingThere.driving: Curbs are for active drop-off and pickup only. The free Cell Phone Lot is next to the P4 Daily Parking garage, under five minutes from all terminals. Through Nov 6, 2026, access to P4 from southbound Brewster Road and the I-78 entrance from Brewster Road near P4 are detoured. The Port Authority urges pre-booking parking at least 3 hours ahead to avoid a peak drive-up surcharge.

construction2026: AirTrain Newark replacement work: through Nov 20, 2026, AirTrain service to and from the Airport Train Station (NJ Transit/Amtrak) is suspended on weekdays from 5am to 3pm. Shuttle buses replace it, and AirTrain service between terminals is not affected.
Runway 4L-22R is under a $121 million rehabilitation, with periodic nightly weekday closures. The airport advises checking with your airline for delays.
The FAA's hourly flight cap at Newark (72 arrivals and departures per hour) runs through Oct 24, 2026
Through Nov 6, 2026, access to P4 Daily Parking from southbound Brewster Road and the I-78 entrance from Brewster Road are detoured
On the nights of Oct 14 and 15, 2026 (10pm-5am), two lanes of the main airport entrance before the ramp to Terminal B/C parking are closed
Terminal C for-hire vehicle pickups have permanently moved from the curb to Level 3 of the Terminal C garage
EWR.bagDrop: Delta (no EWR-specific exception): bags must be checked at least 45 minutes before domestic departures, international check-in closes 1 hour before, and you must be at the gate 15 minutes before departure. JetBlue at EWR: check-in and bags 45 minutes before domestic departures and 60 minutes before international. United's EWR cutoffs could not be verified.
tips: If you are flying from Terminal A by train, the AirTrain does not stop at Terminal A. Allow about 15 minutes to walk the covered path, or take the 5-minute shuttle.
Until Nov 20, 2026, the AirTrain to the NJ Transit/Amtrak station is replaced by shuttle buses on weekdays from 5am to 3pm. Allow extra time on weekday mornings.
United flies from both Terminal C and Terminal A, and an airside shuttle links the two after security, so check your departure terminal
At Terminal B, CLEAR is only for passengers flying from gates B40-B49

faq.q: How early should I get to Newark airport?
faq.a: The airport does not publish a set time. JetBlue and Delta recommend 2 hours before domestic flights, and Delta recommends 3 hours for international. Allow extra time if you arrive by train on a weekday morning, because AirTrain shuttle buses replace trains to the rail station from 5am to 3pm through Nov 20, 2026.

faq.q: Does the AirTrain go to Newark Terminal A?
faq.a: Not directly. From the AirTrain, Terminal A is about a 15-minute walk on a covered path or a 5-minute shuttle ride.

faq.q: Can I walk between terminals at Newark after security?
faq.a: No. A continuous airside shuttle links Terminals A and C after screening, but there is no airside link to Terminal B. You reach Terminal B by the landside AirTrain.

FLL.betweenTerminals: Landside, walk along the curbside walkways or the parking-garage walking trail (follow ground-level arrows), or ride a parking-garage tram. securityWaits.summary: FLL does not publish typical waits. On Mar 14, 2026, during spring break, the cruise season and the federal shutdown, the Terminal 1 TSA line stretched outside the building. Cruise days: Friday, Saturday, Sunday and Monday mornings

FLL.precheckNotes: The airport links to TSA's PreCheck schedule page for checkpoint opening and closing times instead of publishing its own. PreCheck lane locations by terminal were not verified from an official source.
FLL.touchlessId: FLL appears on an April 2026 list of the 65 airports offering TSA PreCheck Touchless ID. Which airlines support it at FLL was not confirmed from an official source; opt in through your airline profile and check your boarding pass for the Touchless ID indicator.

gettingThere.rideshare: Drop-off is on the upper level (Departures) outside each terminal. Pickup is on the lower level: Terminal 1 riders use a temporary area beyond the taxi podium (Zone Z), Terminal 2 riders use GTA-2, and Terminals 3 and 4 riders cross to the first floor of the southern Palm Garage (Zones A-D).
gettingThere.transit: Free Tri-Rail shuttle buses run from lower-level stops at the terminals to the Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport Tri-Rail station in Dania Beach, a few miles away. Tri-Rail serves Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach counties. Broward County Transit Route 1 stops at the Rental Car Center, Stop G. Port Everglades is about a 10-minute ride (taxi about $12). For PortMiami the airport says to allow at least 90 minutes.
gettingThere.driving: The airport is at 100 Terminal Drive. The Palm, Hibiscus and Cypress garages have more than 11,000 spaces; long-term is $2 per 20 minutes, up to $20 per day. During peak periods, valet and self-parking can temporarily close when full, and FLL posts updates on X and Facebook.

construction2026: Post-security terminal connectors (Terminals 1-2 and 2-3), about $260M, were targeted for late 2027 completion as of 2024 reporting

The lower-level ground-transportation pickup between Terminals 2 and 3 (GTA 2) has been closed since March 10, 2025 for the connector construction, and GTA 4 east of Terminal 4 since April 11, 2025. Hotel, off-airport parking and Rental Car Center shuttles now use GTA 1 and GTA 3.
Ride-share pickup has moved: a temporary Zone Z serves Terminal 1, and Terminals 3 and 4 use the Palm Garage's southern first floor

Spirit Airlines shut down on May 2, 2026, and Air Canada moved to Terminal 4 on Sep 15, 2026. An August 2026 travel guide says terminal and gate assignments are more fluid than usual during FLL's capital program.
FLL.bagDrop: During peak cruise activity, FLL says airlines may only check bags up to 2 hours before your scheduled flight. The airport also notes that some airlines won't accept bags earlier than 2-3 hours before departure, and you must check bags before going through security. Airline-specific cutoffs were not verified.
tips: On cruise days (Fri-Mon), many returning cruise passengers reach FLL around 8:30am for flights all day, so terminals can be crowded. Don't arrive hours early, because airlines may not take your bags until 2 hours before departure.

Check FLL's 'Where Is My Airline' page before you go. Spirit no longer operates (shut down May 2026), Air Canada moved to Terminal 4 in Sept 2026, and JetBlue splits between Terminal 3 (domestic) and Terminal 4 (Puerto Rico, Dominican Republic, Jamaica).
Returning a rental car: the Rental Car Center is next to Terminal 1, which you reach on foot via the Level 2 bridge. Shuttles to Terminals 2-4 run every 10 minutes, 24/7.
Garages can temporarily close when full during peak periods, so have a backup plan and check FLL's social media updates before driving

faq.q: How early should I get to Fort Lauderdale airport (FLL)?
faq.a: FLL doesn't publish a single recommended arrival time, and says to check your airline's check-in times. During peak cruise periods, airlines may only accept checked bags up to 2 hours before your flight, so arriving much earlier than that may mean waiting with your luggage.

faq.q: Which terminal is my airline in at FLL?
faq.a: Per FLL's airline directory: Southwest, United, Frontier, Alaska, Allegiant and Breeze are in Terminal 1; Delta and WestJet in Terminal 2; JetBlue (domestic), American, Avelo, Porter and Sun Country in Terminal 3; and Air Canada, Avianca, Air Transat and some JetBlue international flights in Terminal 4.

faq.q: Can I walk between terminals at FLL after security?
faq.a: Generally no. Post-security connectors between Terminals 1-2 and 2-3 are still under construction, so you walk between terminals landside via curbside walkways or the garage trail and re-clear security. 2026 travel guides say Terminals 3 and 4 are connected airside.

IAD.betweenTerminals: Single main terminal. After security, the AeroTrain, an underground walkway to Concourse B, and Mobile Lounges connect the terminal to the midfield concourses; leave extra time to reach A, C and D gates.
IAD.precheckNotes: The main TSA PreCheck checkpoint sits between the East and West checkpoints on the Departures level. IAD.touchlessId: TSA lists Touchless ID at 65 airports and tells travelers to check with their airline. Delta lists IAD as a participating airport (without a dedicated Touchless ID bag drop). A March 2026 third-party list includes United, American, Delta and Alaska among participating airlines at IAD.

gettingThere.rideshare: Pickup is at the 3rd curb on the ground level outside Baggage Claim (Doors 2, 4 or 6), zones 3A-3H assigned in the app. Rideshare drop-off is NOT on the departures level: since Nov. 1, 2023 all rideshare drop-offs are at curbs 3A/B and 3G/H, with a short walk inside to escalators up to ticketing.
gettingThere.transit: Metrorail Silver Line: the Washington Dulles International Airport station connects to the main terminal's ticketing and baggage claim levels (and Parking Garage 1) by an indoor pedestrian tunnel with moving sidewalks.
gettingThere.driving: Parking options include a Valet Lot, Garages 1 and 2, Terminal Hourly, Terminal Daily and Economy lots. The airport occasionally closes the Main Terminal arrivals and departures roadways overnight for construction (e.g., 11pm-5am July 23-24, 2026), detouring traffic to the rideshare lanes.

construction2026: Concourse E (14 gates, United) is scheduled to open in fall 2026; MWAA's board was told in September 2026 the opening slipped from late September into October. It will be renamed Concourse C later, and design-construction of its next segments began in 2026.
Overnight closures of Main Terminal arrivals/departures roadways have occurred for construction (11pm July 23 to 5am July 24, 2026), with pickup/drop-off detoured to rideshare lanes.

A roughly $22 billion Dulles overhaul announced July 29, 2026 would replace the Mobile Lounges with an expanded train, a central walking tunnel and new concourses, plus a 32,000-space garage; construction could start in spring 2027.
IAD.bagDrop: Delta (not an exception airport for Delta): domestic bags must be checked at least 45 minutes before departure (30 minutes without bags); bags not accepted more than 6 hours before departure. United's IAD cutoffs were not verified.
tips: Budget time after security: most gates are reached by the AeroTrain, a walkway or a Mobile Lounge rather than on foot from the checkpoint.
Rideshare drop-off is on the ground-level 3rd curb (3A/B or 3G/H), not the upper departures curb; take the escalators up to ticketing.
Screening runs 24/7: when the East and West checkpoints close, use the lanes next to TSA PreCheck in the middle of the Departures level.
The Silver Line station connects to the terminal through an indoor tunnel with moving sidewalks, so Metro riders never go outside.
United's new Concourse E opens in fall 2026; check your gate, as some United flights will use it.

faq.q: How early should I get to Dulles (IAD)?
faq.a: Dulles recommends arriving 2 hours before domestic flights and 3 hours before international flights. Allow extra time to reach midfield gates by AeroTrain or Mobile Lounge.

faq.q: Is TSA security at Dulles open 24 hours?
faq.a: Yes. The airport says screening is available 24/7; overnight, when the East and West checkpoints close, use the screening lanes next to TSA PreCheck on the Departures level.

faq.q: Where do Uber and Lyft drop off at Dulles?
faq.a: Rideshare drop-offs are at ground-level curbs 3A/B and 3G/H outside Baggage Claim, with a short walk inside to escalators up to ticketing. Pickup is at the same 3rd curb, zones 3A-3H.

faq.q: Can I move between terminals after security at IAH?

tips: JetBlue recommends arriving 3 hours early for domestic flights and 4 hours early for international flights at JFK. That is longer than many travelers expect.

The writer used it at the Gates 70-129 checkpoint and said other checkpoints may differ.

gettingThere.rideshare: Uber, Lyft and other ride-share drop-offs: Departures curb Level 3 at Terminals A and B, Level 2 at Terminal C. Pickups: Arrivals curb Level 2 at A and B 24 hours a day (also the Level 3 Departures curb from 9:00pm to 2:00am); Arrivals curb Level 6 at Terminal C.

Brightline trains to South Florida use the MCO Train Station, open daily 5am-11pm. The airport's approximate taxi fare to downtown Orlando is $38-$45.

The airport says to expect only a few extra minutes.

Through Fall 2027, trips to Gates 70-129 may include a COBUS shuttle hop during the Gate Link replacement, so build a few extra minutes in after security

faq.q: How early should I get to Orlando airport (MCO)?

faq.q: Which terminal is my airline in at MCO?

faq.q: Can I get from Terminal C to Terminals A and B after security?
faq.a: No. Terminal C has its own single checkpoint, and you must clear security again for Terminals A and B. You connect landside on the 24-hour Terminal Link from Terminal B plus a walk of about 1,200 ft through Garage C, or on the 24-hour shuttle bus.

MIA.precheckNotes: Per MIA's checkpoint list, PreCheck runs during checkpoint hours at Checkpoints 1 (Concourse D), 5, 6, 7 (Central) and 8, 9, 10 (South). Checkpoints 2, 3, 4 and DFIS in Concourse D are not listed with PreCheck. Checkpoint 9 is the only one open 24 hours.

construction2026: PHL's nearly $2 billion modernization program continues through 2026. The airport says construction itself can affect the traveler experience.
Garage C is listed as closed. Garages A, B, D and E/F and Economy Parking are open.
PHL.bagDrop: Delta at PHL: domestic check-in and bags close 45 minutes before departure, international check-in closes 1 hour before, and you must be at the gate 15 minutes before departure. tips: The Terminal C checkpoint is PreCheck-only. Without PreCheck, use another checkpoint. Every checkpoint leads to every terminal once you are through.
PreCheck lanes close early in the evening: A-East at 6:30pm and C and D/E at 8:00pm. Plan for standard screening on evening departures.
Terminals B and F have only standard screening. Any checkpoint reaches every terminal, so PreCheck members can use the PreCheck checkpoints (C, A-East or D/E) during their hours.
Alaska, JetBlue and Sun Country passengers check in at Terminal E, but their gates are in Terminal D
Garage C is closed. Use Garages A, B, D or E/F, or the Economy Lot ($18 per day with 24-hour shuttles).

faq.q: How early should I get to Philadelphia airport?

faq.q: Does PHL have CLEAR?

faq.q: Can I walk between terminals at PHL after security?
faq.a: Yes. Once screened, you can walk between terminals without re-entering security, and any checkpoint gives access to any terminal.

Harbor Dr. A three-lane airport entrance road opened Aug 1, 2025, just past Laurel St & Harbor Dr, giving a signal-free route to both terminals. construction2026: Terminal 1 Phase 1B under way (11 more gates, completion 2028); the original Terminal 1 is being demolished
The roadway between Terminals 1 and 2 is closed to all traffic during construction; use the Inter-Terminal Shuttle (4 a.m.-2 a.m.)
Terminal 1 to Terminal 2 East connector in design, construction expected to begin in 2027

SAN says departures operate without penalty only between 6:30 a.m. and 11:30 p.m.

faq.q: Which terminal is Southwest in at San Diego?

SEA.betweenTerminals: Everything is one terminal. Concourses A-D connect by walkway, and the SEA Underground train runs to the N and S satellite concourses. Buses connect the satellites during train maintenance, including intermittent overnight closures through 2027.

securityWaits.summary: SEA says the new Checkpoint 1 and redesigned Checkpoint 6 (opened 2025) have lines moving quickly, with over 94% of travelers getting through in 20 minutes or less. More than a third of daily passengers arrive before 9 a.m.

SEA.precheckNotes: PreCheck is offered at Checkpoints 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6, but not 4. Checkpoint 3 PreCheck runs only 4 a.m.-8 p.m., Checkpoint 2 closes at 4 p.m., and Checkpoints 1 and 5 close at 8 p.m. After 10 p.m. only Checkpoints 3 (to 11:30 p.m.) and 4 (24 hours, no PreCheck) are listed as open. SEA's wait-times page lists slightly different screening types per checkpoint than its security page; SEA says hours and types are approximate, so check terminal signage.
SEA.touchlessId: TSA PreCheck Touchless ID is offered at Checkpoint 3 (4 a.m.-8 p.m.) and Checkpoint 6 for participating airlines only. gettingThere.rideshare: Uber and Lyft drop off at the terminal on the airport drives; at peak times drivers may use the Arrivals drive to avoid traffic. Departures drives are often congested 6-8 a.m. Pickups are on the 3rd floor of the parking garage (stalls 1-34).
gettingThere.transit: Sound Transit Link light rail takes about 38 minutes from downtown Seattle. The Airport/SeaTac station connects to the terminal via the parking garage and 4th-floor skybridges, and a free Train-to-Plane shuttle runs between the station and the garage 5 a.m.-midnight.
gettingThere.driving: Arrive via the Airport Expressway; parking on its shoulders is illegal. The on-site garage has more than 11,000 spaces: drive-up General Parking on Levels 1-3, 6-8 and Level 5 Rows A-M, and Reserved Parking on Level 4 and Level 5 Rows N-W, bookable up to 120 days ahead. The free Cell Phone Lot is off the S. 170th St exit.

Parking garage elevator refurbishment causes intermittent closures; as of an Aug 14, 2026 update, all yellow elevators were out of service
SEA Spot Saver, the free security-appointment program, ends November 30, 2026
S Concourse Evolution (international concourse renovation) is approved and in design
SEA.bagDrop: Alaska: check-in and bag drop typically close 40 minutes before departure, earlier for international. Delta: bags at least 45 min before departure, check-in at least 30 min without bags, at the gate 15 min before. Southwest: bags 45 min, check-in 30 min (domestic).
tips: In the morning, get dropped off on the lower Arrivals level to skip the congested Departures drive (SEA's own 'think opposite' advice)
Checkpoint 4 is the only 24-hour checkpoint but has no PreCheck lane. Late-night PreCheck travelers should know most PreCheck lanes close at 8 p.m.
Book SEA Spot Saver at Checkpoint 4 for a free reserved screening time (4 a.m.-10 p.m., 60-240 min before departure) until it ends Nov 30, 2026
Flights at N or S gates need extra minutes for the SEA Underground train, or a bus if the train is down
During peaks your flight may board by bus from the D Annex (Gates D21-26, across from D5) when gates are full
Reserved garage parking (Level 4 and Level 5 Rows N-W) guarantees a space; drive-up parking can mean extra time hunting for a stall in busy periods

faq.q: How early should I get to Sea-Tac?
faq.a: The Port of Seattle advises arriving two hours before a domestic flight and three hours before an international flight. More than a third of the day's passengers arrive before 9 a.m., so early-morning departures are the busiest.

faq.q: Which Sea-Tac security checkpoint should I use?
faq.a: Any checkpoint reaches all gates. Checkpoints 1-3 are closest to A and S gates, Checkpoint 4 to B and C gates, and Checkpoints 5-6 to C, D and N gates. PreCheck is not offered at Checkpoint 4.

faq.q: How long is the Link light rail ride from downtown Seattle to Sea-Tac?
faq.a: The Port of Seattle says it is about a 38-minute ride. From the Airport/SeaTac station, walk through the parking garage to the skybridges, or take the free Train-to-Plane shuttle (5 a.m.-midnight).

faq.a: SFO says arrival recommendations vary by airline and day of travel, and points to TSA's advice of 2 hours before domestic flights and 3 hours before international flights. Add time for parking or transit, checking bags and security.

faq.q: Can I use any security checkpoint at SFO?
faq.a: Yes. SFO says you can enter at any checkpoint in any terminal with a same-day boarding pass, and once through you can walk to all gates.

faq.q: Where do I check in for United at SFO during Terminal 3 construction?
faq.a: United's west-end Terminal 3 counters are closed. Check in at Terminal 2's west-side United counters for D and E gate flights, or at Terminal 3's east-end counters for F gate flights.

SLC.name: Salt Lake City International Airport

officialArrivalAdvice.domestic: Arrive 2 hours prior to boarding for a domestic flight
officialArrivalAdvice.international: Arrive 3 hours prior to departure for an international flight

terminals.name: Main Terminal (Concourses A and B)

checkpoints.notes: Listed as open 3:30am-1:00am; the same SLC page gives regular PreCheck hours at this checkpoint as 3:30am-10:00pm. Hours subject to change. Onsite PreCheck enrollment is available in the CLEAR lane.
checkpoints.name: Main TSA checkpoint, Level 2

checkpoints.notes: Open 6:00am-5:00pm; serves international arrivals with connections and departing passengers.
checkpoints.name: International checkpoint, ground level (International Arrivals area)

notes: Single terminal with two long concourses (A and B) reached after security; Concourse B is reached by the Mid-Concourse Tunnel or the Central Tunnel (opened fall 2024).

Official walking times from the post-security terminal (not using moving walks): about 9.5 min to the west end of Concourse A, 7 min to the Central Tunnel end of Concourse B, 8.5 min to the east end of Concourse A, and about 14 min to either far end of Concourse B (21 min if you stand on the moving walks).

Ten Concourse B-east gates opened in October 2025 for Delta and Southwest; four more opened July 14, 2026, and the final seven Phase 4 gates (serving United plus two common-use gates) open October 27, 2026.
Departures drop-off is on the elevated roadway to Level 3; stay right on Terminal Drive.

SLC.betweenTerminals: One terminal; Concourses A and B are connected after security by the Central Tunnel and Mid-Concourse Tunnel (walk with moving walkways).

securityWaits.summary: SLC has identified peak departure times when higher volumes of passengers depart; the airport homepage shows a live security wait estimate.

SLC.precheckNotes: PreCheck is at the main Level 2 checkpoint; SLC lists regular PreCheck hours there as 3:30am-10:00pm, so late-night travelers may not have a PreCheck lane. TSA PreCheck enrollment is offered in the CLEAR lane.
SLC.touchlessId: TSA lists Touchless ID at 65 airports and tells travelers to check with their airline. Delta lists SLC as a participating airport with dedicated Touchless ID bag drop. A March 2026 third-party list shows Alaska, American, Delta, Southwest and United participating at SLC.

gettingThere.rideshare: Rideshare (TNC) pickup is at signed curbside zones on the ground level outside the terminal (B-Lane). General passenger drop-off is the elevated roadway to Level 3.
gettingThere.transit: UTA TRAX Green Line: the Airport station is on the ground level on the east side of the terminal (exit door 1A and go east). One-way fare $2.50.
gettingThere.driving: Stay right on Terminal Drive for the Level 3 departures drop-off. Reserve parking in advance for the garage, Lot E and long-term/economy parking. 13-foot height limit in front of the terminal. Free Park and Wait lot for drivers picking up.

construction2026: Phase 4 (final phase) of The New SLC: the last seven Concourse B-east gates and six concessions open October 27, 2026; some paving and ancillary work may extend into early 2027.
Terminal Drive exit lanes were repaved in phases May 11-27, 2026, with two lanes kept open.
SLC.bagDrop: Delta: domestic bags must be checked at least 45 minutes before departure (30 minutes if no checked bags); bags not accepted more than 6 hours before departure; be at the gate 15 minutes before departure.
tips: Budget walking time after security: the far ends of Concourse B are about 3,000 feet from the checkpoint, roughly 14 minutes at a steady walk.
The Central Tunnel (opened 2024) cuts the walk to the middle of Concourse B to about 7 minutes versus 15 minutes via the older Mid-Concourse Tunnel.
SLC lists PreCheck hours at the main checkpoint as 3:30am-10:00pm; late-evening flyers may face standard screening.
Reserve parking ahead: SLC urges advance reservations for the garage, Lot E and economy parking during busy periods.
TRAX Green Line stops right outside the east side of the terminal (door 1A) if you want to skip parking.

faq.q: How early should I get to Salt Lake City airport?
faq.a: SLC recommends arriving 2 hours before boarding for domestic flights and 3 hours before international departures. Add time for the walk: the farthest Concourse B gates are about 14 minutes on foot from security.

faq.q: How long is the walk to the gates at SLC?
faq.a: According to the airport's walking-time chart, it takes about 7 to 14 minutes (not using moving walks) from the post-security terminal to Concourse A or B gates, and up to about 21 minutes if you stand on the moving walkways to the far end of Concourse B.

faq.q: Does SLC have TSA PreCheck and CLEAR?
faq.a: Yes. The main Level 2 checkpoint has PreCheck (regular hours 3:30am-10:00pm per the airport) and a CLEAR lane, where you can also enroll in PreCheck.

TPA.betweenTerminals: Check-in and bag drop are in the Main Terminal, which has a Red Side and a Blue Side by airline. Each of the four airsides is reached by its own automated shuttle and has its own TSA checkpoint. To change airsides you ride back to the Main Terminal and clear security again at the other airside.

securityWaits.summary: TPA says TSA lines are often under 10 minutes and rarely over 30-40 minutes even at peak times. The busiest hours across all airsides are typically 5-7am. Ticket counter and bag check lines can be longer than security in busy periods. Live wait-time monitors were only at the Airside A shuttle lobby as of March 2026.

TPA.precheckNotes: A Kayak airport guide says all four airside checkpoints have TSA PreCheck lanes. TPA's own hours for PreCheck lanes could not be verified.
TPA.touchlessId: A March 2026 list of TSA PreCheck Touchless ID airports shows TPA for Alaska, American, Delta, Southwest and United. You opt in through your airline profile.

gettingThere.rideshare: Uber drops you at the curb for your airline. Rideshare riders can choose the Red Express Curbside as a pickup or drop-off point, per TPA. Pick the Red or Blue side that matches your airline.
gettingThere.transit: HART and PSTA buses stop next to the SkyConnect station at the Rental Car Center; take SkyConnect from the Main Terminal. HART Route 30 runs to downtown Tampa. PSTA's new 727 Airport Express runs from downtown St. Petersburg via the Howard Frankland Bridge express lanes, about 5am-11pm daily, $2.25 one way; Bay News 9 reported it launched by early October 2026.
gettingThere.driving: Follow signs to the Red or Blue side for your airline. Express Curbsides on both sides let travelers with no checked bags and an electronic boarding pass skip the ticketing level. Short Term, Long Term and Economy garages are getting new ticket and payment machines with tap-to-pay and plate readers (due to finish October 2026). If you leave within 60 minutes, the plate reader opens the exit arm. A free cell phone lot is off George J. Bean Parkway.

construction2026: Airside D (16 gates, Delta as anchor tenant) is under construction northwest of the Main Terminal and is scheduled to open in 2029. Overnight closures on George J. Bean Parkway have been needed for shuttle guideway work, with more expected.
A multi-year checked baggage system rebuild is underway (TPA, September 2026). Construction walls block some Red Bag Claim carousels on the first floor.
CLEAR+ lanes and eGates are planned for all four airside checkpoints, expected fall 2026. The contract took effect October 1, but no opening was confirmed.
TPA.bagDrop: Southwest: bags checked less than 45 minutes before a domestic departure may not be accepted (60 minutes for international); bags are accepted no earlier than 4 hours ahead. Delta: check bags at least 45 minutes before domestic departure, no more than 6 hours ahead. American: check-in and bag deadline is 45 minutes before domestic departure.
tips: Know your airside and your side. Your airline sets both the Red or Blue check-in side and the airside (A, C, E or F) you take the shuttle to.
Security is at each airside, not in the Main Terminal. Switching airsides means screening again.
With no checked bag and a mobile boarding pass, use the Red or Blue Express Curbside and go straight up to the shuttles.
Early mornings (5-7am) are the busiest time. Airside A checkpoint opens at 4am; C and E at 3:30am; F at 3:15am.
TPA says bag check and ticket counter lines can run longer than security at busy times, so add time if you are checking a bag.

faq.q: How early should I get to Tampa airport?
faq.a: TPA recommends 2 hours before domestic flights and 3 hours before international flights. Security is usually under 10 minutes, but bag check lines can be long at peak times.

faq.q: Do I need to go through security again to change airsides at TPA?
faq.a: Yes. Each airside has its own checkpoint. You ride the shuttle back to the Main Terminal, then take the shuttle to the other airside and clear security there.

faq.q: Does Tampa airport have CLEAR?
faq.a: Not yet confirmed. TPA approved CLEAR+ lanes and eGates for all four airsides, expected in fall 2026, but this research found no confirmed opening date.

faq.q: Which side is Southwest at TPA?
faq.a: Southwest checks in on the Red Side of the Main Terminal and flies from Airside C.
